title: Christina Aguilera Gears Up for ‘Xtinaween’ With X-Rated Bathtub Selfie
summary: She's not wearing her costume -- or anything at all -- just yet.
contentText:
Xtina is putting the “X” in “X-rated” this Halloween. Ahead of the year’s spookiest holiday, Christina Aguilera shared a highly NSFW selfie from her bathtub.

Related

The Instagram photo shared on Wednesday (Oct. 28) shows the pop star standing in her bathtub while snapping the pic in the mirror, which shows her nude reflection. Only two strategically placed thematic ghost emojis cover a bit of skin.

“last looks before xtinaween” Aguilera captioned the picture, adding ghost, jack-o’-lantern and devil emojis.

The caption implies that the five-time Billboard Hot 100 -topper has an epic costume teed up, but for now she’s not wearing it (or anything, for that matter) on the ‘gram. Her previous Halloween looks include Cher as Tess in Burlesque — in which Aguilera costarred as Ali — in 2023.

When Xtina does share her look, she’ll join stars such as Paris Hilton, Kim Kardashian, North West, Lizzo, Chloe Bailey and more in taking part in the festivities .

The explicit selfie comes shortly after Aguilera made a surprise appearance at Chappell Roan’s Super Graphic Spectacular show in Los Angeles on Oct. 21, belting out her 2002 smash “Beautiful” before joining the Midwest Princess in duetting on “Coffee.”

“I want to introduce this person [who] honestly paved the way for me and all women in pop to do whatever the f–k they want, sing and wear whatever the f–k they want,” Roan said of Aguilera on stage. “I’m so grateful to have her. She’s a f–king legend.”

The vocalist last dropped a proper studio album, the Spanish-language Aguilera , in 2022, reaching No. 16 on the Billboard Top Latin Pop Albums chart.
